title: REQ · BootScene fades out and starts the scene named in transitionTo
summary: On transitionTo the scene fades the camera out, then starts the requested scene.
description: Context: BootScene.create (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) has no transitionTo listener. Desired behavior: a listener registered in create() calls cameras.main.fadeOut and, once on FADE_OUT_COMPLETE, calls scene.start(sceneId). Expected result: React-driven transitions play a fade before the new scene begins. Why: smooth scene changes for SG-11.
acceptance_criteria: Given create() ran, when transitionTo { sceneId: 'library' } is emitted, then cameras.main.fadeOut is called with a positive duration.
Given the fade-out was requested, when FADE_OUT_COMPLETE fires, then scene.start is called with 'library' exactly once.
Given no transitionTo was emitted, then fadeOut and scene.start are never called.
